_meta: Coverage-blind re-judge (ANALYSIS, not the official metric). Each stored candidate re-judged by the official Sonnet judge in two modes: control = 5 dims + 'which set is better overall'; blind = 4 dims (coverage removed from the rubric AND the A-vs-B verdict). quality = 0.5*(mean-1)/4 + 0.5*pairwise over answered cases. Control reproduces the logged quality (validation), so the blind delta is trustworthy. Finding: removing coverage changes quality ~0 and the pairwise verdict ~0 — the on-device model still loses ~22-24/30 to gold even when coverage is ignored, so the gap to the frontier is BROAD (a uniform ~1 rubric point below on nearly every dimension), not coverage-specific. Generated by autoresearch/rejudge_coverage_blind.py; pw = [fmBetter, tie, goldBetter].
